edges.reason: toggleSaleStatus writes the saleIsActive flag.
withdraw reads store as the ETH recipient.
withdraw performs a low-level value call forwarding all remaining gas.
The low-level call sends the contract balance to store.
store receives control during the call and can re-enter withdraw.
reserveTokens mints reserved crates through _safeMint.
reserveTokens records startingIndexBlock when unset.
reserveTokens is onlyOwner and mints to msg.sender.
mint requires saleIsActive to be true.
mint bounds totalSupply plus count by MAX_SUPPLY.
mint enforces count lower than or equal to MAX_NFT_PURCHASE.
mint computes the required payment from NFT_PRICE.
mint loops and calls _safeMint for each requested crate.
The untrusted caller address is used as the mint recipient.
calcStartingIndex writes the derived startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock for blockhash entropy.
calcStartingIndex uses MAX_SUPPLY as the modulus.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex to be unset.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock.
setBaseURI writes into _baseURIExtended.
_baseURI reads _baseURIExtended.
tokenURI reads the per-token URI mapping.
tokenURI calls the _baseURI hook.
_safeMint triggers the receiver callback for contract recipients.
The receiver callback is executed by _checkOnERC721Received.
A malicious receiver can re-enter mint during _safeMint.
A malicious receiver can re-enter reserveTokens during _safeMint.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
onlyOwner guards withdraw using msg.sender.
onlyOwner guards calcStartingIndex using msg.sender.
onlyOwner guards emergencySetStartingIndexBlock using msg.sender.
onlyOwner guards setBaseURI using msg.sender.
count parameter drives the mint purchase logic.
baseURI_ parameter is stored by setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter selects the queried token URI.
to parameter is the recipient passed to _safeMint.
tokenId parameter is the id passed to _safeMint.
_data parameter is forwarded to the receiver callback.
balance local captures address(this).balance in withdraw.
sent local stores the low-level call success flag.
supply local holds totalSupply() in reserveTokens.
reserve_i is the loop counter of reserveTokens.
mint_i is the loop counter of mint.

normalization_plan.reason: mint parameter count is consumed solely by the mint function body.
setBaseURI parameter baseURI_ is consumed solely by the setBaseURI function body.
tokenURI parameter tokenId is consumed solely by the tokenURI function body.
_safeMint parameter to is consumed solely by the _safeMint function body.
_safeMint parameter tokenId is consumed solely by the _safeMint function body.
_safeMint parameter _data is consumed solely by the _safeMint function body.
withdraw local balance is the value transferred by the unsafe low-level call.
withdraw local sent is the result flag of the unsafe low-level call.
reserveTokens local supply is consumed solely by the reserveTokens function body.
reserveTokens local loop counter is consumed solely by the reserveTokens function body.
mint local loop counter is consumed solely by the mint function body.
